PhoneHarness is a remote control interface for DSH running on your computer and does not provide model capabilities itself.

Text and images you send from your phone are delivered through the computer address you entered straight to the DSH on your own computer, processed by the local model and streamed back; there is no third-party server in between and no content is retained.

Connection information (the computer address and the access token) is stored only on this device and is cleared as soon as you sign out.

Only connect to computers you trust; do not tell others the address and pairing code on public Wi-Fi.

This app is provided as is; missing results caused by a network interruption, the host not running, or an error from the model itself are not considered a service failure.

① Connect to your computer
Open DSH on your computer and tap the Phone remote entry to see a 6-digit pairing code; open this app on your phone, enter the LAN IP and port of the computer, then enter the pairing code.

② Send images
In the + button on the left of the message input you can take a photo, pick an image from the gallery, or choose a file. Only images are supported for now; other file types cannot be sent.

③ Cannot connect
First make sure the phone and the computer are on the same Wi-Fi and that DSH is still running on the computer, then re-test the connection in Computer connection.

④ Feedback
Give the symptoms, your phone model, and the computer-side logs to the person using the computer.
